findings.detail: Uncited: document_budgets constructs each variant's execution plan twice with identical arguments, first for summation and then for validation. This duplicates timeout-parameter wiring and unnecessarily allocates every plan twice.
findings.fix: Construct each plan once inside the variant loop, validate it, and accumulate its step timeouts.
findings.title: Uncited: Reuse each execution plan for summation and validation.

findings.detail: Uncited: execute repeats planned-versus-direct dispatch separately for commands and pipelines, producing four invocation sites with repeated journal and target arguments. Dispatch-option changes require synchronized maintenance even though both runners accept the same interface here.
findings.fix: Select the runner and payload first, then share one planned dispatch branch and one direct dispatch branch, retaining the exception handler.
findings.title: Uncited: Share dispatch wiring between commands and pipelines.

strengths: Process launches share one deadline-checking boundary.
Fingerprint planning and execution reuse the same operation declarations.
summary: Reviewed all 162 membership paths and required committed diffs for reuse, including generated-mirror comparisons. Two localized cleanup suggestions remain. The review was read-only; tests were not run.
